top_signals.title: Oracle Kicks Off $20 Billion Capital Raise to Fund AI Spending
top_signals.summary: Oracle Corp. has kicked off an effort to raise $20 billion in debt and equity, just days after unveiling a long-term fundraising plan to finance its artificial intelligence infrastructure spending spree.

top_signals.summary: Meta, Tiktok and X will face a tougher battle resisting Ofcom’s demands for online safety data after the High Court ruled that tech giants must provide detailed evidence of compliance costs in order to challenge the regulator’s requests.
